# requires: store
#
# The lease protocol as an observer sees it. Every line here is something a
# caller branches on: whether it got the job, which epoch it holds, and which
# of the three ways of not holding it any more happened to it.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
claim A alpha 1500
claim A beta 1500
progress A alpha 16 {"verified_prefix":16}
sleep 1900
progress A alpha 24 {"verified_prefix":24}
claim A beta 1500
progress A alpha 32 {"verified_prefix":32}
progress A beta 32 {"verified_prefix":32}
release A beta
state A

# expect 3: lease-held
# expect 6: lease-expired [JOB-L5]
# expect 6: done=16
# expect 8: stale-epoch [JOB-L1]
# expect 8: done=16
# expect 9: ok state=running [JOB-S1]
# expect 9: done=32
# expect 10: ok state=pending [JOB-L6]

# Step 3 cites nothing on purpose. No rule on either page says a live lease
# refuses another claim — the pages describe the epoch, the expiry and the sweep,
# and leave the plainest thing the lease does to be inferred.
